record.title: Validate existing and newly created worker mapped-access observation
record.intent: Establish bounded multi-thread observer controls before stock initialization advances.
requirements: Use private freestanding ARM64 controls in the pinned disposable guest; no stock application run in this batch.
Seize and interrupt a known leader and pre-existing worker with clone-event reporting before releasing their fixture gate.
Prove a worker read fault is attributed to its TID and a narrowly guarded synthetic completion reaches shared fixture output.
Observe a subsequently created worker through the clone event and stop on its next mapped access without supplying another response.
Include unexpected-offset and write-direction arms that terminate without an unsupported response.
Record thread group and tracer identities, wait statuses, registers, instruction and mapping bindings, and complete child cleanup.
Bound thread count, event count and wall time; preserve guest enforcement and system_server stability.
acceptance: Independent verification distinguishes pre-existing attachment, newly traced thread startup, worker fault delivery and guard rejection.
Either controls pass or their precise negative outcome is preserved without broadening the fixture in place.
Explicitly retain the gap between a fixed private thread schedule and arbitrary stock thread creation races.
